exposure: Morbidly obese women undergoing cesarean section (BMI > 45 kg/m2)
Use of incisional negative pressure therapy
cohort: 63 morbidly obese women (BMI > 45 kg/m2) undergoing cesarean section
finding: This pilot study suggests a decrease in wound complications in morbidly obese women receiving incisional negative pressure therapy following cesarean section.
mod_finding: This pilot study suggests a decrease in wound complications in morbidly obese women receiving incisional negative pressure therapy following cesarean section.
